explanation: Voltmarkt builds weekly units from a zero-filled product by week series, so the week without sales counts as 0 and the baseline is (18 + 22 + 20 + 0) / 4 = 15 units a week. The promotion averaged (39 + 51) / 2 = 45. Uplift = 100 x (45 - 15) / 15 = 200.0%. Averaging only the three weeks with rows gives a baseline of 20 and an uplift of 125.0%, which understates the effect.
